summary: postinstall fetches and executes a binary from a bare-IP host with TLS verification disabled
details: The package's postinstall lifecycle script (ensurePlatformBinary) downloads a platform-specific tarball from the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz/, extracts it, chmods the extracted binary to 0755, hardlinks it into bin/.onecode, and symlinks bundled asset directories. The fetch uses https.get with rejectUnauthorized: false (TLS certificate verification disabled), follows arbitrary redirect Location headers, and performs no hash or signature verification on the downloaded bytes. The source IP is not associated with any @onescience-branded publisher domain. On any default `npm install`, the fetched bytes are staged into the package's own bin directory and then executed whenever the onecode CLI is invoked, giving any party controlling that IP (or on the network path between the installer and that IP) the ability to substitute arbitrary code that runs on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
